alternatives.name: foundation-agent-retrieval-bench
alternatives.why_not_default: Selected, but its scope is narrow. The upstream replay is one positive-only code-file retrieval task: 101 cases, 82 of them from Gin and Click. It was run on a recorded macOS arm64 host (README.md line 36), not this WSL host, and has no abstention metric and no agent-repair outcome (README.md lines 3-24). The local fixture is public-document retrieval: 15 docs and 24 source-authored queries, not an external holdout. It records no host and has no abstention or accuracy metric (evaluation-receipt.json lines 43, 64, 67-70). Neither run covers financial documents. The packet card's statement that no benchmark was run is superseded by these retained receipts.

alternatives.name: inspect-ai
alternatives.why_not_default: Selected because it fits agent-task evaluation, but the evidence is source review only. Nothing has been installed or run: installation_performed false and model_calls 0 (architecture-wave record, lines 124-125). The record's own next acceptance has no retained receipt. That acceptance (line 123) is one mock-model task with deterministic scoring, bounded concurrency/retries, a retained failure log, and interruption and resume, with no provider request.

alternatives.name: data-mlflow
alternatives.why_not_default: Selected for experiment tracking, but the evidence is source review only. The catalog card marks the sqlite synthetic-run workflow as prospective and unexecuted. No tracking run, artifact store or access control has been observed (catalogs/us-equities/data-research.json lines 779-817).

alternatives.name: mlflow
alternatives.why_not_default: Same repository and version (v3.16.1) as c1, but pinned only by tag, while c1 carries an exact source commit. Its role (artifacts, lineage, optional traces) duplicates c1, and the traces also overlap the observability layer. There is no tracking-server execution evidence (catalogs/us-equities/agents-operations.json lines 1688-1726).

alternatives.name: data-river
alternatives.why_not_default: Covers progressive evaluation, but only for online or streaming learning. Its own card says immediate synthetic labels are invalid for financial online evaluation and require modelling of delayed labels, corrections and restarts. Nothing was executed (catalogs/us-equities/data-research.json lines 1304-1340).

alternatives.name: foundation-mteb
alternatives.why_not_default: An embedding and retrieval evaluator that has never been run here; its commands are prospective. The 2.21.0 pin is behind upstream 2.21.6, and the reviewed commit is a default-branch snapshot that can differ from the tag. Unlike c7, it has no retained run on the frozen local fixture (catalogs/us-equities/foundation-memory.json lines 1210-1245).

alternatives.name: phoenix
alternatives.why_not_default: Tagged for both the observability and agent-evaluation layers, as a trace UI plus evaluation workspace, so it overlaps the observability layer. Server launch is prospective, no app has been instrumented and no judge calls were made. The catalog card gives the license as Elastic-2.0 with restrictions, while the packet's upstream metadata says NOASSERTION. Auto-instrumentation can capture prompt and tool contents (catalogs/us-equities/agents-operations.json lines 1239-1280).

alternatives.name: promptfoo
alternatives.why_not_default: Not a candidate in this packet; it appears in the foundation quality-evaluation packet. Its us-equities card (agents-operations.json lines 1321-1361) tags it agent-evaluation and security, with evidence_level source_review and prospective commands. A retained execution does exist. evidence/artifacts/promptfoo-nemotron-upstream-20260921/qualification.json records a promptfoo 0.123.1 eval with exit_code 0: 1 case passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, with retained recovery and failure notes. That run was NVIDIA's four-query embedding-retrieval example against a local vLLM endpoint with a locally authored assertion. Its own limitations say it is not held-out qualification, and it evaluates no agent task. It is recorded in challenger_preferred and is not promoted.

challenger_preferred.name: promptfoo
challenger_preferred.required_comparison: A matched run over the frozen fixture blueprints/convergence-practice/local-fixture/fixture.json (fixture_sha256 aea5e9616fb19eb1d2fd58ecfadf88ff087d7d2e79b4a70bc9f88207af9d0402, with corpus-manifest.json) using a mock model and 0 provider calls, with two arms: c2 inspect-ai 0.3.266 and promptfoo 0.123.1. Each arm must score deterministically under bounded concurrency/retries, retain a failure log and survive interruption and resume. Record the exit code, per-case scores recomputable from rankings.json, and resume success. The comparison is decided on those observed results; lane agreement does not count.
challenger_preferred.why: It is tagged for this layer's agent-evaluation scope and has a retained native eval run: exit_code 0 and 1 of 1 case passed (evidence/artifacts/promptfoo-nemotron-upstream-20260921/qualification.json). c2 (inspect-ai), by contrast, has no installation or run (installation_performed false). promptfoo is also listed as an optional component in manifests/stack.json line 689. Its executed scope is a four-query retrieval example, not an agent task, so on current evidence it does not outrank c2 for agent-task evaluation. It is not in this packet and is not selected.

limits: Every packet evidence_ref is a remote URL (GitHub README, PyPI or release pages). I have no network tool and did not open them, so their contents are unverified. I removed them from winner_evidence_refs and relied on locally retained catalog cards and receipts.

My grep of the handbook for evidence-class definitions also matched lines 431 and 1725-1727. These appear to be earlier layer-verdict text, including a quality-evaluation row for promptfoo and a local-fixture classification for this layer. Their content did not determine this verdict, but I cannot claim independence from them. For the same reason I did not read the prior claude-lane artifact for this layer.

I also saw fields the packet withholds, namely the catalog-card decision/rationale values and the architecture-wave decision block. The selection rests on evidence class and scope fit, but I cannot guarantee it is independent of those fields.
I read arb-trace2code/receipt.json only through a grep, and did not read fixture.json, rankings.json or corpus-manifest.json beyond confirming that they exist.
I could not run commands. The metrics and hashes are copied from the receipts, not recomputed.
The client did not expose the actual model or effort beyond the fixed packet values. The environment reports Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5[1m]). The skill path is <host-path>/SKILL.md.
No TypeSafe inference results were supplied or used. The refuters' findings are provider judgments that I re-checked against the cited sources; everything else is this lane's own source review.

Revision corrections from the refuters' findings: (1) the local-fixture run is public-document retrieval with no host recorded, not code retrieval on macOS; (2) c2 is not the only agent-evaluation candidate, since c6 carries that layer tag; (3) the c2 acceptance includes bounded concurrency as well as retries; (4) the macOS host citation is README.md line 36; (5) overturn_protocol now names the frozen input fixture.json and gives separate metric sets for the two receipts; (6) promptfoo was added as challenger_preferred, without promotion.
open_gaps: inspect-ai, mlflow (both cards), river, mteb and phoenix have no retained execution; their evidence is source review only.

c7's upstream replay is code-file retrieval on a recorded macOS arm64 host. Its local-fixture run is public-document retrieval with no host recorded. Neither covers financial documents, agent task outcomes, abstention, or a recorded run on this WSL host.

promptfoo's retained run is a four-query embedding-retrieval example with a locally authored assertion. The record does not name the host OS; it shows only a local 127.0.0.1 vLLM endpoint. It does not establish agent-task evaluation.

The packet requirement text is shared by the group: native identity, supervising owned processes, and keeping research workers away from broker execution. No candidate has evidence of process supervision or of withholding broker authority.
No candidate has retained evidence for validation-reporting, or for progressive evaluation with delayed labels on financial data.

Pin discrepancies remain unresolved. c7's packet evidence_ref is snapshot 07014c9, while the executed release commit is b487f38 (the receipt records an identical source tree). For c2, the packet's upstream.latest 'release/2025-11-28' does not match the PyPI pin 0.3.266. For c6, upstream.latest refers to a different package (@arizeai/phoenix-mcp@4.3.13).
c6's license conflicts between sources: the packet says NOASSERTION and the catalog card says Elastic-2.0.

c2 inspect-ai 0.3.266 mock-model task with deterministic scorer over the same fixture
promptfoo 0.123.1 (non-packet challenger) mock-provider eval with deterministic assertions over the same fixture
c1 mlflow 3.16.1 local sqlite run recording the receipt's parameters, metrics and artifact hashes
overturn_protocol.metric: Local-fixture arms: exit code, Recall@1/Recall@3/Recall@5 and full-ranking MRR as a macro mean over the 20 positive queries, with the 4 no-gold rankings retained, all recomputable from ranked paths. ARB replay arms: Recall@5/Recall@10/Recall@20 and full-ranking MRR over 101 cases. Agent-evaluation arms: deterministic score, bounded concurrency/retries, a retained failure log, interruption/resume success, and provider_calls == 0.

overturn_when:
The verdict changes if a new retained receipt shows a better result for another arm:

- **Retrieval evaluation:** c5 (mteb) runs on the frozen input blueprints/convergence-practice/local-fixture/fixture.json with the same corpus-manifest.json hashes and cutoffs 1/3/5. The run must exit 0 with Recall@1/3/5 and full-ranking MRR that can be recomputed from the ranked paths. It must either beat c7's ARB BM25 result (MRR 0.9666666666666666) or add abstention coverage for the 4 no-gold queries.
- **Agent evaluation:** the matched comparison of c2 inspect-ai and promptfoo on that fixture, as described in challenger_preferred, has one of two outcomes. Either c2 fails its recorded next acceptance (mock model, deterministic scoring, bounded concurrency/retries, retained failure log, interruption and resume, 0 provider calls), or promptfoo meets the same acceptance while c2 does not. In either case c2 is replaced.
- **Experiment tracking:** a c1 local sqlite run fails to record the fixture receipt's parameters, metrics and artifact hashes. c1 is then demoted in favour of a measured alternative.

<host-path>/local-fixture (glob: fixture.json, corpus-manifest.json, rankings.json, freeze-receipt.json, evaluation.md, evaluation-receipt.json)
docs/grand-catalog-handbook.md (grep native_proven|local_integration; used only for the class definitions on lines 108-109)
why_selected:
I judged the candidates against the layer title and its layer_scope_terms: evaluation, agent-evaluation, experiment-tracking, progressive-evaluation and validation-reporting. Together the three winners cover retrieval evaluation, agent-task evaluation and experiment tracking. Only c7 has executed evidence.

c7 (agent-retrieval-bench v0.2.1) has two retained runs of different kinds.

- **Upstream replay (native, recorded host macOS arm64).** blueprints/convergence-practice/arb-trace2code/README.md (lines 3-11, 28 and 36) and receipt.json record an offline replay of the complete 101-case v2_trace2code release. The replay is code-file retrieval from failure traces. It used the unmodified lexical and BM25 evaluators at commit b487f3866cc13dd971819cb902517a6a50282404. Results were lexical Recall@5 0.343234 / MRR 0.207453 and BM25 Recall@5 0.222772 / MRR 0.163848. 15 upstream tests passed.
- **Local integration (no host recorded).** blueprints/convergence-practice/local-fixture/evaluation-receipt.json has kind executed_frozen_public_document_retrieval_fixture (line 67). It ranked 15 public documents from the native-agent-stack repository at base commit bf99d340 against 24 source-authored queries: 20 positive and 4 no-gold. BM25 MRR was 0.9666666666666666 and Recall@1 0.95; lexical MRR was 0.9 and Recall@1 0.8. The run had provider_calls 0 and execution_exit_code 0. This receipt records no host or OS, and it has no abstention metric (lines 43, 70).

Neither run evaluates financial documents.

c2 (inspect-ai 0.3.266) is the candidate whose role, "Programmable task/solver/scorer evaluations", best fits evaluating an agent's task outcome. c6 (phoenix) is also tagged agent-evaluation, but as a trace-inspection workspace. c7 evaluates retrieval only. c2's evidence is source review only: catalogs/convergence-practice/architecture-wave/UKGovernmentBEIS__inspect_ai.json records installation_performed false and model_calls 0 (lines 124-125).

c1 (data-mlflow v3.16.1, commit 32792afe5b0183fce10532d3a023f5cfa8612d09) covers experiment tracking with an exact source pin. It is source review only; catalogs/us-equities/data-research.json lines 779-817 mark its sqlite workflow as prospective.

The weakest class in the winner set is therefore source_review.
